name: application-multi-file-attachment-row
title: Multi-File Attachment Row
description: Row of attached-file chips with a type badge, filename, and a real human-readable file size computed from bytes — distinct from the drag-and-drop file-uploaders component.
useWhen: Listing files that have already been selected or uploaded, alongside a form or message composer.
You want the file size label (KB/MB) computed from real byte counts rather than hand-typed.
Each file needs an individual remove action rather than the full drag-and-drop upload UI.
avoidWhen: You need the drop zone and upload-progress UI itself — use file-uploaders instead.
Files need per-item upload progress bars — extend this component's data model or use file-drop-preview-list.
There's only ever one file at a time — a single inline file chip is simpler than a list.
responsiveBehavior: Each row's filename truncates with an ellipsis at narrow widths rather than wrapping, keeping every row a fixed height.
accessibility: Each remove button carries an aria-label naming the specific file being removed, not just "Remove".
File size is always shown as real text (e.g. "2.4 MB"), not implied by icon or chip size.
The type badge shows the real file extension derived from the filename, not a generic icon guess.

variants.title: Multi-file attachment row
variants.description: Three attached files (PDF, PNG, CSV) with computed sizes and remove buttons, on a light surface.
accessibility: File size formatting switches between B/KB/MB based on the real byte count, matching common OS file-size conventions.

variants.title: Multi-file attachment row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three attached files, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Chip, badge, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
